content: minipro/TL866 CLI write-protection grammar exists in TWO opposite polarities across forks. wholder/MiniPro help text: '-u  Do NOT disable write-protect' / '-P  Do NOT enable write-protect' => default behaviour is unlock-before-write AND re-lock-after-write, both opt-OUT. DavidGriffith/minipro (current maintained fork) man page: '-u, --unprotect  Disable protection before programming' / '-P, --protect  Enable protection after programming' => reads as opt-IN action flags. Vocabulary is stable across both (protect/unprotect); polarity is not. Also note minipro uses 'skip_erase'/'skip_verify' naming for its skip flags.
